title: Filipino-Style Leche Flan
description: A rich and creamy Filipino-inspired dessert made with eggs, sugar, and leche flan. Perfect for special occasions and parties.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the leche, granulated sugar, and 1/4 cup of the milk. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, vanilla extract, and remaining 3/4 cup of milk.
Gradually add the hot leche mixture to the egg mixture, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Pour the mixture into 6 (1/2 cup) ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
To serve, run a knife around the edges of each ramekin and invert onto plates. Garnish with a sprinkle of granulated sugar, if desired.
